label: Update YAMP Shopping List
info:
Alexa "Shopping List" -> YAMP (https://meals.marcuslab.uk).

Replaces the "Update Vikunja Shopping List" tab. Cut over by disabling
that tab and enabling this one in the same deploy; roll back by swapping
the two flags again.

Three differences from the Vikunja flow, all deliberate:

1. The Alexa item is removed only after YAMP returns 2xx. The Vikunja
   flow removed it in parallel, so a failed write lost the item.
2. Removal goes through the list API (removeItem, by item id and
   version) instead of speaking "remove X from my Shopping List" at an
   Echo. No device dependency, no 5s delay, nothing to mis-hear.
3. Each add carries a UUIDv5 derived from the Alexa item id as its
   idempotency key, so the 40s poll and the ws-todo-change push cannot
   double-add the same item.

The Alexa list is therefore a queue: anything YAMP rejects or cannot be
reached for stays on it and is retried on the next poll.

Needs YAMP_TOKEN in the nodered container environment (a labelled token
from POST /auth/tokens). YAMP_URL is optional and defaults to
https://meals.marcuslab.uk.
